conviction_note: No pre-release, no profit warning and no Q3 consensus I could source. Nordic consumer peers that reported Q3 were strong (Boozt, Clas Ohlson, Byggmax, Lyko), but BHG has already risen about 10.5% over the three sessions in which those peers came out, and this name sold the two most recent prints that beat on sales. The findings sum (-0.2) and the scaled number (-0.34) agree in sign, and both are small for that reason.

findings.finding: Nordic consumer and e-commerce peers that reported Q3 2026 since BHG last spoke were strong. Byggmax Q3 (Nordic DIY): sales +7.1%, like-for-like +5.1%, operating profit 292m (258). Clas Ohlson September organic +12%. Boozt pre-announced Q3 growth of 16-17% and raised its outlook. Lyko Q3 sales +23.8%. Together they point to a healthy Nordic home/DIY demand backdrop for BHG's Q3 sales line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sales beats have not been enough on their own: Q2 2026 beat sales by about 2.4% and the stock fell 17.0% on a margin miss. Q3 2025 beat sales by about 5.8% and the stock opened +6.0% and closed -2.3% (Yahoo tape, issuer release dates).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced already. BHG rose +4.1% on 2026-10-20 (Byggmax day) and closed +5.0% on 2026-10-22 (Lyko/Nelly day) on above-average volume, about +10.5% over three sessions. If the market had not read it, the 5-day run-up would be flat rather than +12%. What remains is that these are peers rather than BHG, and BHG's tougher comparison (Q3 2025 organic +13.4%) may not be fully mapped.

findings.finding: Husqvarna Q3 2026: Forest & Garden organic -10%, driven by widespread drought across Europe and weak consumer demand in Germany and France. BHG's Q2 growth driver was robotic lawn mowers and gardening equipment, and Germany is one of BHG's growth markets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not separable. Garden mix was the stated cause of the Q2 2026 margin miss (-17.0% day).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly offsetting and ambiguous. BHG rose on 2026-10-21, the Husqvarna day (20.40 to 20.62), so the market did not read it as negative for BHG. Q3 is a smaller garden quarter for BHG, and less garden mix was the Q2 margin fix, so the net sign is uncertain. Sized small.

findings.finding: BHG faces its toughest growth comparison of the year: Q3 2025 organic growth was +13.4% with double-digit organic growth in all three business areas, against +9.6% organic in Q2 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Growth deceleration was read negatively in Q4 2025 (organic below Q3, stock -3.8% on 2026-01-27).
findings.why_not_priced: Public for a year, so analysts model it. The only unpriced element is whether a peer-driven rally has pushed the whisper above what the comparison allows. Kept small.

findings.finding: BHG ran up +12.1% over 5 sessions and about +10.5% over the last three (19.60 to 21.66 SEK close 2026-10-22, sealed spot 21.72) into a print. On the last two sales beats the stock was sold: Q3 2025 opened +6.0% and closed -2.3%, Q2 2026 closed -17.0%. The bar has risen into the release.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up is itself the price. The finding is that the run-up came from peer read-through rather than anything BHG said, so it raises the bar BHG has to clear. A short register that is small and unchanged (0.59%) means there is no squeeze fuel to offset that.
findings.independence: Peer releases dated 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-22 (Byggmax, Lyko) coincide with the up days. See finding 1 sources.

findings.finding: The Q2 margin shortfall had stated, partly transitory causes: garden-equipment mix and 'challenging comparative figures in the bathroom category' (Home Improvement adj EBIT margin 4.7% vs 5.2%). Management called it a mix effect, and Q3 is seasonally less garden-weighted, so the mix headwind should ease. Profitability had improved year on year for 11 consecutive quarters against an easy Q3 2025 base of 3.6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin is the line this stock trades on: Q2 2026 margin miss of 1.0pp gave -17.0%. Q1 2026 adj EBIT in line or slightly above gave +7.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: After the Q2 miss the consensus was cut (Simply Wall St reports the PT down 10% to 29 SEK), so the margin bar is probably lower than before. Whether it is lower than this mix argument implies cannot be checked without a sourced Q3 consensus. Capped small for that reason.
